noun_definition: Split bill refers to the action of dividing expenses among multiple users in the context of the application, where the user expects to see images of the users involved rather than their names in the preview.
User name refers to the identifier displayed in the preview when splitting a bill, which the user expects to be replaced by user images instead.
iou refers to a feature in the application that displays user information related to bill splitting, which in this case is expected to show user images instead of names.
